name: omp-semantic-policy
description: Semantic policy enforcement for Oh My Pi

showStatus.description: Show semantic policy state in OMP's native status bar.

showViolationFeedback.description: Show session feedback when policy denies, revises, or requires approval for an action.

confirmationDefault.description: Resolve confirmation requests when no dialog is shown. Deny (default) blocks unapproved actions; approve explicitly opts into fail-open behavior. Explicit policy denials remain blocked.

confirmationThreshold.description: The default 1 keeps decisions automatic without dialogs. Set below 1 to opt into prompting at or above this confidence; 0 prompts for every uncertain checked action. Other requests use confirmationDefault; prompts block without an interactive UI.

enabledToolCalls.description: Comma-separated exact OMP tool names for remote semantic evaluation. Defaults to mutation, execution, delegation, and process-control tools; routine inspection and lsp (including write to xd://lsp) skip TypeSafe. Local path protections and intent checks remain active. Explicitly empty evaluates every tool call.

disabledToolCalls.description: Comma-separated exact OMP tool names that skip remote semantic evaluation, for example bash. Local protections remain active. Empty keeps all current remote enforcement defaults.

scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
